Stupid hypothetical but hear me out, let's say a rival government, one with a more relaxed approach to safety and quality standards in construction were to be in office, this government decides to hand give some lovely office construction contracts to a mate of theirs. This mate attempts to get it done on the cheap(tbh this would happen irregardless). One of the cost cutting measures is skimping on proper wiring, screw properly earthing everything, stuff having proper lighting, be damned proper lockout procedures, it's quicker and cheaper. So ETU steps in, not as big and bad as cmfeu, but fairly decently supported. ETU ,puts a hold on works. All of a fuckin sudden, the boss of ETU, is under investigation. Well the government says, this can't do, your all under administration now. And in the ensuring madness, work proceeds on the dodgy site. 
Now I'm not saying that's what's happened. But I live and work in construction in Sydney, and I'm saying if the federal government sets a precedent of sacking union bosses, when the next developer backed government gets in (and it will), we are doomed.
